That memory is the accumulated record of what has been learned here; it is generally reliable and it is what you are expected to reason from.

    simplify_onboarding · promotional_pricing · referral_incentive ·

action you currently intend. Answer with the structured object only.

answer.rationale: The current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. While the provisional direction is simplify_onboarding, the durable memory indicates that activation_messaging (memory_91) improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful actions. Given that onboarding completion decline is modest (4%) compared to activation decline (6%), and considering that simplification alone may not address the engagement gap, activation_messaging offers a more direct lever for the activation problem. I'm verifying memory_31 to confirm that signup simplification's benefits are still holding, which will help contextualize whether additional onboarding work is needed or if product-side messaging is the higher-leverage intervention. The competitive pricing pressure on SMBs is noted but is secondary to our core activation metric decline—addressing engagement will strengthen our competitive position more than chasing price-sensitive accounts.
